BiblicalUsage: Rab is an archer — the bowman. Job says of God in his suffering, 'His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder,' and Jeremiah calls the archers against Babylon, 'all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows.'
TheologicalSignificance: What strikes me is that Job's image is the honest one: when suffering comes from every side, it feels like archers circling, and Job still spoke to the God behind the bow.
